name: AIRI Factorio Server (Swarm E2E)
author: noreply@ttlouis.space
description: Development AIRI Factorio channel for swarm E2E testing. Reinstall resolves the latest feat/swarm-pterodactyl-playable commit to an exact SHA. Restart never updates code. The bundled chat/LLM loop remains single-NPC while the installed Autorio runtime exposes swarm coordination APIs and deterministic swarm test coverage.

installation.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Generated AIRI Factorio channel installer: swarm-e2e
# Reinstall follows feat/swarm-pterodactyl-playable; restart keeps the installed exact SHA.
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077
PAYLOAD_REF="d6a6ba815cb724c9622d8a980a9c781cc60c0cb8"
EXPECTED_PAYLOAD_SHA256="40537a476eb189a613a7d0ed6cd8ffb1fee36a1c34aa6dcb136172659edd0fbf"
DEFAULT_SOURCE_REF="feat/swarm-pterodactyl-playable"
CHANNEL="swarm-e2e"
SOURCE_REF="${AIRI_SOURCE_REF:-$DEFAULT_SOURCE_REF}"
BASE="$(mktemp)"
PATCHED="$(mktemp)"
RESOLUTION="$(mktemp)"
log() { printf '[AIRI channel:%s] %s\n' "$CHANNEL" "$*"; }
fail() { log "ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 78; }
cleanup() { local code=$?; trap - EXIT; rm -f -- "$BASE" "$PATCHED" "$RESOLUTION"; exit "$code"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'exit 130' INT
trap 'exit 143' TERM HUP
for tool in bash curl sha256sum awk grep mktemp rm tr; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || fail "Missing channel installer tool: $tool"; done
[[ -n "$SOURCE_REF" && "$SOURCE_REF" != -* && "$SOURCE_REF" != */../* && "$SOURCE_REF" != ../* && "$SOURCE_REF" != */.. && "$SOURCE_REF" != *' '* ]] || fail 'Invalid AIRI_SOURCE_REF'
if [[ "$SOURCE_REF" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ ]]; then
  RESOLVED_SHA="$SOURCE_REF"
else
  curl --fail --location --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 60 --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' \
    --get --data-urlencode "sha=$SOURCE_REF" --data-urlencode 'per_page=1' \
    'https://api.github.com/repos/TTLouis/airi-factorio/commits' --output "$RESOLUTION" \
    || fail "Unable to resolve AIRI_SOURCE_REF=$SOURCE_REF"
  RESOLVED_SHA="$(grep -m1 -oE '"sha"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[a-f0-9]{40}"' "$RESOLUTION" | grep -oE '[a-f0-9]{40}' || true)"
  [[ "$RESOLVED_SHA" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ ]] || fail "AIRI_SOURCE_REF did not resolve to a commit: $SOURCE_REF"
fi
log "Resolved $SOURCE_REF -> $RESOLVED_SHA"
URL="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TTLouis/airi-factorio/$PAYLOAD_REF/deploy/pterodactyl/payload-src/installer.sh"
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 900 --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' "$URL" --output "$BASE" \
  || fail 'Unable to download immutable AIRI installer payload'
ACTUAL_PAYLOAD_SHA256="$(sha256sum "$BASE" | awk '{print $1}')"
[[ "$ACTUAL_PAYLOAD_SHA256" == "$EXPECTED_PAYLOAD_SHA256" ]] || fail 'Immutable AIRI installer payload checksum mismatch'
[[ "$(grep -Ec '^AIRI_REF="[a-f0-9]{40}"$' "$BASE")" == 1 && "$(grep -c '^AIRI_REF=' "$BASE")" == 1 ]] || fail 'Unexpected AIRI_REF assignment contract in immutable payload'
[[ "$(grep -Ec '^REVISION="[A-Za-z0-9._-]+"$' "$BASE")" == 1 && "$(grep -c '^REVISION=' "$BASE")" == 1 ]] || fail 'Unexpected REVISION assignment contract in immutable payload'
SHORT_SHA="${RESOLVED_SHA:0:12}"
awk -v ref="$RESOLVED_SHA" -v revision="$CHANNEL-$SHORT_SHA" '
  /^AIRI_REF=/ { print "AIRI_REF=\"" ref "\""; next }
  /^REVISION=/ { print "REVISION=\"" revision "\""; next }
  { print }
' "$BASE" > "$PATCHED"
grep -Fxq "AIRI_REF=\"$RESOLVED_SHA\"" "$PATCHED" || fail 'Failed to apply resolved source SHA'
grep -Fxq "REVISION=\"$CHANNEL-$SHORT_SHA\"" "$PATCHED" || fail 'Failed to apply channel release revision'
log "Installing exact source $RESOLVED_SHA from $SOURCE_REF"
bash "$PATCHED"

variables.name: AIRI Source Ref
variables.description: Git branch, tag, or exact 40-character commit SHA followed when this swarm egg is reinstalled. Restart does not resolve or update this ref.

variables.name: AIRI Actor Mode
variables.description: Controlled actor mode. The chat supervisor remains one standalone NPC while the installed Autorio runtime is swarm-capable.

variables.name: AIRI Chat Players
variables.description: Players allowed to issue !airi commands. Leave blank or use * to allow everyone. Enter comma-separated exact player names for an allowlist. Use none to disable in-game AIRI commands.

variables.name: OpenAI API Key
variables.description: Provider credential. Kept environment-only and never written to airi-config.json.

variables.name: AI Model
variables.description: OpenAI-compatible model identifier used by AIRI. Replace the placeholder with a model supported by your provider.

variables.name: Provider Base URL
variables.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL. Replace the non-routable placeholder; remote endpoints must use HTTPS.

variables.name: Provider Timeout (ms)
variables.description: Maximum time for one provider response before the AIRI turn is cancelled and reported in game.

variables.name: Save File Name
variables.description: Save under /saves. Leave blank to use the newest existing save or create airi-world.zip.

variables.name: Factorio Username
variables.description: Factorio.com username used for public server listing. Leave both username and token blank for a hidden/private server.

variables.name: Factorio Authentication Token
variables.description: Factorio.com authentication token used for public server listing. Leave both username and token blank for a hidden/private server.

variables.name: Shutdown Timeout (ms)
variables.description: Graceful Factorio save/stop timeout before forced termination.

variables.name: Factorio Version
variables.description: Factorio 2.0 headless version: latest, experimental, or exact 2.0.x release.
